card.name: Inside long drug names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a long drug name that is still being spelled out, most often the 'ft' in ivacaftor or lumacaftor. It also fires on middle pieces of names like tramadol, candesartan cilexetil and butorphanol.

modes.label: Ivacaftor/lumacaftor
modes.description: The 'ft' inside lumacaftor or ivacaftor in dosing tables for oral granules.
modes.example: 75 mg/ivacaftor 94 mg oral granules 1 packet of lumacaftor 75 mg/ivaca<<ft>>or 94 mg oral granules

modes.label: Other drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of another long drug name, such as tramadol, cilexetil or butorphanol.
modes.example: DROCHLORIDE EXTENDED-RELEASE TABLETS WARNING: SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATENING RISKS FROM USE OF TR<<AM>>ADOL HYDROCHLOR

card.plain: It marks the middle of a long drug name as the name is being spelled out.
